name: Media Genie Support
author: PUJI Design

sections.description:
Media Genie Support streamlines your media workflow:

  • Auto-rename uploaded images for better organization and SEO.
  • Choose which image sizes to generate — save storage and avoid clutter.
  • Retina (2×) image support for high-resolution displays.
  • Folder management: create folders, assign media, filter by folder.
  • Default folder per post: automatically organize media for posts.
  • Folder color labels: quickly identify and differentiate folders.

Lightweight, fast, and fully integrated into the WordPress media library.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/media-genie/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Tool > Media Genie to configure plugin options.
